messages:
Maya P: Quick idea — spontaneous ramen crawl this Friday? start at Ichiban on 5th around dinner. :ramen:
Jon H: heck yes. can we do karaoke after? :microphone:
Ivy Z: ramen sounds perfect. karaoke maybe later, low-energy tonight tho. :sleeping:
Oscar R: Ichiban gets packed. should we aim 6:15 so we can grab a bigger table?
Maya P: quick poll: 6:00 / 6:15 / 6:30?
Lunchbot: Poll created: "Ramen start time" — Options: 6:00, 6:15, 6:30. Current votes: 6:00 (2), 6:15 (1).
Jon H: i'll pick 6:00, can make an early train. bringing cash for rounds.
Ivy Z: 6:15 is easier for me (train runs late). can we meet in lobby at 6:10 and walk over?
Maya P: ok let's compromise — meet lobby 6:05, leave by 6:15 for Ichiban. if you're early, grab a coffee nearby.
Maya P: karaoke after? OpsBot — any private rooms free around 8pm?
OpsBot: Checked venues: Karaoke Kube has two private rooms available at 8:00. Deposit required; refundable with cancellation 24h prior.
Oscar R: i'll cover the deposit and we can split. who wants in for karaoke?
Jon H: count me in for karaoke and a beer tab.
Ivy Z: i'll join ramen but might skip karaoke — vote optional.
Maya P: any dietary needs? Ichiban has vegetarian broth option and a tofu ramen.
Ivy Z: vegetarian works for me, thanks.
Maya P: final RSVP so far: Maya, Jon, Ivy, Oscar. See you Friday — lobby 6:05, Ichiban 6:15. Karaoke optional, deposit split at venue. :tada:
